questions.text:
If '[latex] \rightarrow [/latex]' denotes increasing order of intensity, then the meaning of the words [dry [latex] \rightarrow [/latex] arid [latex] \rightarrow [/latex] parched] is analogous to [diet [latex] \rightarrow [/latex] fast [latex] \rightarrow [/latex] _____].
Which one of the given options is appropriate to fill the blank?
questions.solution:
dry [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] arid [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] parched: increasing degree of lack of water.
diet [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] fast [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] ___ : increasing degree of not eating. Next stronger level is starve.

(reject, feast, deny do not fit the scale.)

Answer: starve

questions.text: If two distinct non-zero real variables [latex] x [/latex] and [latex] y [/latex] are such that [latex] (x+y) [/latex] is proportional to [latex] (x-y) [/latex] then the value of [latex] \frac{x}{y} [/latex]
questions.solution:
[latex]x+y=k(x-y)[/latex] for a constant [latex]k[/latex].

[latex]x+y=kx-ky\Rightarrow y(1+k)=x(k-1)\Rightarrow\dfrac{x}{y}=\dfrac{k+1}{k-1}[/latex]

This depends only on [latex]k[/latex], so it is a constant.

Answer: is a constant

questions.text:
Consider the following sample of numbers:

9, 18, 11, 14, 15, 17, 10, 69, 11, 13

The median of the sample is
questions.solution:
Sorted: 9, 10, 11, 11, 13, 14, 15, 17, 18, 69 (10 numbers).

Median = average of the 5th and 6th values [latex]=\dfrac{13+14}{2}=13.5[/latex]

Answer: 13.5

questions.text:
The number of coins of Rs. 1, Rs. 5, and Rs. 10 denominations that a person has are in the
ratio 5:3:13. Of the total amount, the percentage of money in Rs. 5 coins is
questions.solution:
Let coins be [latex]5k,3k,13k[/latex].
Money: Rs.1 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]5k[/latex], Rs.5 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]15k[/latex], Rs.10 [latex]\rightarrow[/latex] [latex]130k[/latex]. Total [latex]=150k[/latex].

Share of Rs.5 coins [latex]=\dfrac{15k}{150k}\times100=10\%[/latex]

Answer: 10%

questions.text:
For positive non-zero real variables [latex] p [/latex] and [latex] q [/latex], if
[latex] \log \left(p^2+q^2\right)=\log p+\log q+2 \log 3 \text {, } [/latex]
then, the value of [latex] \frac{p^4+q^4}{p^2 q^2} [/latex] is
questions.solution:
[latex]\log(p^2+q^2)=\log(9pq)\Rightarrow p^2+q^2=9pq[/latex]

Squaring: [latex]p^4+q^4+2p^2q^2=81p^2q^2\Rightarrow p^4+q^4=79p^2q^2[/latex]

[latex]\dfrac{p^4+q^4}{p^2q^2}=79[/latex]

Answer: 79
